title: Mall world dream repeated
content: So I’ve been having a repeated/continues dream for a long time, over 2 years. When it first started it was a hotel I was staying in as time went on the area grew a forest, deli, gas station, ghetto, rich area always by a large beach on top of a mountain. I’m not sure what made the dream change but one day in my dreams I started packing getting ready to move and I think I moved down the mountain? This is where the shopping mall comes in. I would say it’s more of a shopping district pretty seedy lots of drugs. Before entering the parking lot there’s large rocks slating to an end ( / kinda like this) and nature on the other side as u walk in farther. This is all on the coast by the beach. The shopping area is right by the beach. The shopping mall is Almost like a china town area. There’s a large bar/ restraunt with a very long, row table down one side that sits as a bar. Most fancy place in the area. Outside there’s clothing stores, dispensaries, drug dealers, cvs type drug store. Walking through is all pretty ally like. at the edge of this shopping town (an area I’ve never passed) is almost I guess a line of crossroads ¥¥¥¥ which is the way out I think. There’s a straight path below them that I follow. I’m usually looking for something around here or meetting with people but I don’t think I’ve ever gone past them. The water is always the ocean and the rocks are important in the dream too.
